name: warm-intro-agent
description: Conversational agent that turns a resume into a shortlist of 5 target roles and 5 recruiter contacts, sourced from LinkedIn or Apollo and scored deterministically.

paragraphs: A guided, conversational job-search agent. Drop your resume, tell it your constraints, and get a shortlist: 5 target roles with application links, and 5 people worth reaching out to — sourced from your own LinkedIn network, a Gemini-grounded public search, or both.

Warm Intro is a multi-step pipeline with a few genuinely autonomous decision points: Gemini derives job-search keywords from your resume rather than making you type them in, and recruiterfinder.py decides (via grounded search + a confidence judge) which public contacts are worth showing you at all. It is not an unbounded agent loop. It doesn't take actions you haven't approved, and every LLM step is bounded and reviewable.

whatItDoes.text: A guided, conversational job-search agent. Drop your resume, tell it your constraints, and get a shortlist: 5 target roles with application links, and 5 people worth reaching out to — sourced from your own LinkedIn network, a Gemini-grounded public search, or both.

requirements.text: No install needed, just bring your own free Gemini API key.
No account, no server, no stored data for the core flow — see Privacy for the one opt-in exception.

The scheduled send (senddigest.py, run by .github/workflows/digest.yml on a daily cron) runs on the operator's own Gemini and Resend API keys, not yours — you never need to keep a personal key alive for a background job you signed up for once.
